problem.statement: Open Food Network Canada reports a map-centering and zoom bug: one mis-geocoded enterprise can shift the map to another continent, making local sellers hard for shoppers to find.

sources.claim: Open issue #14924 describes a real Canadian instance problem and reports a user threatening to leave; maintainer issue text is not independent churn measurement.

repository.description: Established open-source marketplace linking growers, food hubs and purchasers across a global nonprofit network.

fit.documented_capability: Open Food Network includes a public /map for producer discovery and a MapCentreCalculator setting map center from enterprise coordinates.
fit.problem_requirement: A robust, locale-aware map should display the intended country's sellers even if one enterprise is geocoded outside the service geography.
fit.unverified_gap: Issue #14924 identifies extreme-coordinate midpoint and hard-coded zoom defects; no patch, review or measured retention impact is demonstrated in this assessment.

market.buyer_segment: Open Food Foundation engineering team or existing country instance operators (paid contractor fit to confirm)

signals.claim: A published open bug documents current engineering need but not a paid budget for this task.
The foundation publicly advertises applications for paid developer and system administrator contributions; no specific offer or contract has been received.
Maintainer issue names a concrete open engineering problem; it does not promise paid engagement.

paid_onboarding_requirements.claim: Published Open Food Network handbook describes initial volunteer contributions and certification before invoiced paid participation; the current terms must still be confirmed.
